name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Fractional Marketing & Growth Leader
summary: Marketing and growth leader with 15+ years owning the full marketing function in lean, fast-moving environments — comfortable as sole marketing owner where building from scratch is the job. As founder of Solenzo, I run demand generation, lifecycle marketing, CRM architecture, and reporting end-to-end for service-based and B2B clients, then layer AI-driven automation on top to make growth compounding rather than manual. I already operate fractionally: embedded, accountable for revenue outcomes, and translating strategy into systems that keep producing after I hand them off.
